9. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.

10. Service is actions carried out as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing of the impending, ongoing or having occurred violence against victims.
11. Empowerment is the strengthening of women victims of violence to be able to work and earn independently after they are recovered and provided with health and social rehabilitation services.
12. Companion is a person who has the expertise to provide counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
13. Accompaniment is activities and actions carried out by companions to women and children victims of violence during the service process.

14. Counseling is the provision of assistance by a person who is skilled/trained in such a way that the understanding and psychological capacity of the victim and/or perpetrator increases in solving the problems faced.

Huruf a dan  “penghormatan dengan dimaksud Yang adalah  korban” hak-hak terhadap pemenuhan jaminan terpenuhinya hak-hak dasar korban.

Huruf b Yang dimaksud dengan “keadilan” dan kesetaraan perempuan  dimana keadaan adalah gender diperlakukan sama dan memperoleh kesempatan yang sama guna mendapatkan kesempatan (akses), serta kesejahteraan;

Yang dimaksud dengan “kesetaraan gender” adalah dan  manfaat kesempatan, hak, kesamaan pengambilan keputusan antara perempuan dan laki-laki termasuk dalam memasuki kesempatan kerja baik di sektor formal maupun informal.

Huruf c Yang dimaksud dengan “non diskriminasi” adalah sikap dan perlakuan terhadap korban dengan tidak jenis  usia, dasar atas pembedaan melakukan kelamin, ras, suku, agama dan antar golongan.

Huruf d Yang dimaksud dengan “kepentingan terbaik bagi yang  terbaik tindakan semua adalah korban” oleh  dilakukan yang korban menyangkut Pemerintah Daerah, masyarakat, badan legislatif dan badan yudikatif, sehingga kepentingan yang terbaik bagi korban harus menjadi pertimbangan utama.

translated_text:
Article 2

Letter a What is meant by "respect for victims' rights" is the guarantee of fulfillment of victims' basic rights.

Letter b What is meant by "justice" is a state where women and gender equality are treated equally and obtain equal opportunities to obtain access, as well as welfare;

What is meant by "gender equality" is equality of rights, opportunities, benefits and decision-making between women and men including in entering employment opportunities both in the formal and informal sectors.

Letter c What is meant by "non-discrimination" is an attitude and treatment towards victims without making distinctions on the basis of age, sex, race, ethnicity, religion and between groups.

Letter d What is meant by "the best interests of victims" is all the best actions concerning victims carried out by the Regional Government, community, legislative bodies and judicial bodies, so that the best interests of victims must be the primary consideration.

Article 19

Letter a Letter b Letter c Letter d What is meant by "violence prevention system" includes: mapping of locations or areas prone to violence and carrying out preventive and promotive efforts to the community.

Letter e Socialization can be conducted through mass media, electronic media, and direct counseling to the community.

Letter f Critical education is an effort to build awareness of women victims of violence about their rights.

The purpose of implementing critical education is to help women make decisions and not become victims of repeated violence. Forms of critical education for women victims consist of: trainings on gender equality and justice, education on reproductive health and understanding of legislation in the field of protection of women and children.

Ayat (1) Huruf a Cukup jelas Huruf b Yang dimaksud dengan “medicolegal” adalah memberikan  untuk kedokteran pelayanan dalam  optimal yang professional bantuan untuk  kedokteran ilmu memanfaatkan kepentingan penegakan hukum dan keadilan.

Termasuk pelayanan medicolegal antara lain: visum et repertum dan visum et psikiatrikum.

Yang dimaksud dengan “visum et repertum” adalah keterangan tertulis yang dibuat oleh dokter dalam ilmu kedokteran forensik atas berwenang  yang penyidik permintaan mengenai hasil pemeriksaan medik terhadap di  dan keilmuannya berdasarkan korban bawah sumpah, untuk kepentingan proses peradilan.

Yang dimaksud dengan “visum et psikiatrikum” adalah keterangan yang diberikan oleh seorang Dokter Ahli Jiwa tentang kondisi kesehatan jiwa korban yang diperlukan untuk membuat terang suatu perkara dan untuk keperluan proses peradilan.

Huruf c Cukup jelas
translated_text:
Article 36

Paragraph (1) Letter a Sufficiently clear Letter b What is meant by "medicolegal" is to provide optimal professional medical services that utilize medical science to assist in law enforcement and justice.

Medicolegal services include among others: visum et repertum and visum et psikiatrikum.

What is meant by "visum et repertum" is a written statement made by a doctor in forensic medical science at the request of an authorized investigator regarding the results of medical examination of the victim based on their expertise and under oath, for the purposes of judicial proceedings.

What is meant by "visum et psikiatrikum" is a statement given by a Psychiatrist regarding the mental health condition of the victim required to clarify a case and for the purposes of judicial proceedings.

Letter c Sufficiently clear
